root_cause: Chats and agents could produce a green candidate yet still leave routine protected merge/deploy as human follow-up; concurrent workers could also mutate the terminal candidate head.
fix: Current authorized execution node owns protected promotion through production/provider readback.
Routine user follow-up for merge/deploy is forbidden.
One terminal writer lease freezes non-owner branch mutations.
Progress-aware supervisor recovers zero-run, partial-start and stale-queue exact-head delivery without weakening gates.
